Muscle strength.
Power & purity.

Dymatize Creatine is formulated to deliver 5g of micronized creatine monohydrate per serving to support your resistance training goals. Creatine monohydrate is a highly researched form of creatine phosphate, a critical energy resource during high intensity muscle actions like weight training and sprinting.
Creatine is considered by experts to be one of the most efficacious high intensity sport performance supplements.
Dymatize Creatine mixes easily and can be used by itself or blended into shakes or other beverages.

Real science & quality
Dymatize products are formulated based on the latest science and are always manufactured in GMP Certified facilities. They are banned substance tested for athlete's reassurance under the Informal Choice program (www.informed-choice.org).
These statements have not been evaluated by the Food and Drug Administration. This product is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease.
